title: Chapter 182 Ready To Go
content:
Chapter 182 Ready To Go

In the extreme north, farther north than where the Xiongnu and Donghu used to be, there lived a group of the same nomads.

Ding Ling and Su Shen, these people were all losers who were exiled to the north after being defeated in the process of fighting for hegemony with the Xiongnu and Donghu.

More and more losers were driven to the north by them. After a long period of reproduction, these two races now have a population of nearly one million and are extremely powerful.

It can even be said that because they grew up in more bitter cold places, their temperaments are more fierce, tenacious, and their combat effectiveness is stronger.

If they can go south, there are many opportunities to defeat the Xiongnu and Donghu, and regain their lost status.

It's a pity that these people originally had conflicts. After they came to this bitter cold land, they had to fight for a rarer living place. They formed a deep hatred with each other, so how could they join hands and go south together!

Now, these tribes who had been fighting for a day, all stopped, because a piece of news from the south deeply shocked their fragile hearts.

In the south, the Huns or Donghu who had a feud with them have been wiped out.

They wished they could kill the two tribes who had regained their position, and they were easily wiped out like this, silently, in a short time.

Instead, there was a behemoth named Yuguo, which ruled the vast grassland tens of thousands of miles away, and the equally vast plains. They had millions of warriors, spanning the entire northern border.

The newly-emerged them are in the limelight, and they have wiped out the two overlords on the grassland in a short period of time. Now the new overlord's soldiers are pointing at them. How can we not make them feel afraid?

Of course, not all of them who live in a place of bitter cold feel scared. There are always some fools whose brains are damaged by the cold, and they are dazed. Don't you believe in this evil?

Within the two races, dozens of tribes united together, put aside their mutual grievances, and formed two armies of 30,000 to 40,000, each facing their enemy, that is, Yuguo, and arranged them in the northern border to guard against and The left-behind frontier army waiting for an opportunity to attack.

But the result was very miserable. In the head-on confrontation, they were defeated by Yu Guo's endlessly powerful weapons, and they directly eliminated a large number of warriors before they came into close combat.

And when these coalition forces finally escaped this journey of death, they were ready to display their bravery and come to a brave duel of warriors.

It was shocking to find that they were extremely proficient at charging in a loose formation, and the cavalry group of Yuguo was tightly assembled together, forming a torrent of steel.

Like a thin piece of paper, it will be torn if you poke it, and it will be torn to pieces. Then it was trampled into a lump of rotten meat by the iron hooves of the cavalry, and became food for vultures floating in the sky, or dinner for wild wolves hunting outside the battlefield.

Then, there was no more, the two coalition forces were wiped out, and the other tribes who got the news, horrified, sent their own envoys from the alliance to express their surrender.

At this point, the entire northern part of the Yu Kingdom, the grasslands and the bitterly cold glaciers, completely belong to the Yu Kingdom.

His sphere of influence has greatly expanded, opening up tens of thousands of miles of land at one time, although it only belongs to the imperial kingdom in name, and its rule is not very stable.

Now the reason why he can submit meekly like a lamb is because he is deterred by Yuguo's powerful force, and he has to do so in order to survive.

Once Yuguo shows signs of decline, these wolves who have hidden their fangs will show their sharp teeth again, and ruthlessly bite off a piece of bloody flesh on the body of their original owner.

However, it is hard to say whether they will have this opportunity.

For example, Zhong Yu is now planning a strategy of uniting the six countries and jointly attacking Qin.

He only planned to send 100,000 local troops from Yuguo, but Zhong Yu agreed to send 300,000 to Han Fei, so where would the remaining 200,000 soldiers come from? Naturally, the Huns and the North were the two losers.

From the remaining more than 100,000 soldiers of the Xiongnu, 100,000 of them were drawn and transferred to Shangdang and Hangu Pass in the Central Plains to attack Qin.

The 100,000 soldiers drawn by the two nomadic tribes in the north, Ding Ling and Sushen, fell into the territory of the Huns and drove them to attack the northern territory of Qin.

In this way, the troops of Xiongnu, Ding Ling, and Sushen were all transferred to a place they were completely unfamiliar with, surrounded by many enemies.

In such a strange place full of crises, their only reliance is their own kingdom, the master who brought them to such a place.

And they will also have to obey their own orders, even if they are sent to death as cannon fodder.

...

Xinzheng from South Korea returned home at this moment. After meditating all night, Han Fei rushed to the palace at dawn to ask to see his father!

"Han Fei, what do you want to do with me this early in the morning?" King Han's tone was a bit unkind. Early morning is the time when people want to sleep most, and it is natural to stay in bed. Naturally upset.

"Father, it's important to interrupt so early. Last night, my son met His Highness King Jing in the Zilan Pavilion and had a chat!" Han Fei saw that King Han was upset, but said There was a piece of news that made King Han extremely concerned.

"What? You said that you and King Jing met in Zilanxuan and talked for a while!" King Han rubbed his eyes, and looked at Han Fei in disbelief.

"Exactly, His Royal Highness King Jing and his ministers discussed something that could affect the fate of the six countries in the world!" Han Fei nodded and explained his intentions.

"What's the matter?" King Han's impetuous heart completely calmed down, and asked in a deep voice.

"Unite against Qin!" Han Fei could represent everything in just four words.

"However, there have been four times before, and most of them failed, and the goal of destroying Qin was not achieved!" King Han was not blindly happy, but raised his own concerns.

"It's different now. Among the six countries in the world, the three countries of Han, Zhao and Wei are still at the juncture of collapse. They will definitely support the resistance against Qin." Han Fei told the situation of these three countries.

"What about the three countries of Qi, Chu, and Yan? What is their attitude?" King Han, one of them, naturally knows the attitude of these three countries, but he does not understand the attitude of other countries.

"Yan State has just been defeated by Yu State. As long as Yu State has an order, Yan State, which is in a state of fear, naturally dare not refuse. Although Qi and Chu have a somewhat ambiguous attitude towards cooperating, they also understand the current situation in the world. Qin The unification trend of the country is already unstoppable, even if they don't participate, they shouldn't hold back! And, most importantly, the Yu country sent 300,000 troops to attack Qin this time!" After analyzing the other three countries, Han Fei finally pointed out the most important thing A reason for his excitement.

"The 300,000 army, the lonely king understands, and I, South Korea, agree to participate in this alliance!" Han Wang chewed on this number, and finally nodded in agreement with the strategy of jointly attacking Qin.
